title: German aFRR capacity auction results (4-hour blocks, up/down).
source: regelleistung.net (German TSOs) data center, crds API v2
licence: proprietary (copyright German TSOs; reproduction needs prior written consent)
attribution: 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT TSO, TransnetBW via regelleistung.net
transformation_notes: aFRR capacity results (4-hour blocks POS/NEG_hh_hh, Europe/Berlin). price_eur_per_mw_h = GERMANY_AVERAGE_CAPACITY_PRICE_[(EUR/MW)/h]; marginal_price_eur_per_mw_h = GERMANY_MARGINAL_CAPACITY_PRICE_[(EUR/MW)/h]; volume_mw = GERMANY_BLOCK_DEMAND_[MW] from the demands file (falls back to GERMANY_ALLOCATED_VOLUME_[MW] when the demand is missing). direction up = POS, down = NEG.
note: Not redistributed (regelleistung.net terms require prior written consent for reproduction). rows/sha256 describe the locally built file at retrieval time; rebuild with the fetch command.
